categories.main_business_segments: DS Dansuk operates three primary business divisions: Bioenergy, Battery Recycling, and Plastic Recycling. The Bioenergy segment produces and sells biofuels such as biodiesel, bio-heavy oil, and bio-marine fuel targeting global refineries, shipping companies, and power plants. The Battery Recycling segment collects and recycles lead-acid batteries to produce refined lead and is preparing to enter lithium-ion battery recycling. The Plastic Recycling segment manufactures and sells additives for petrochemical products and is developing post-consumer recycled (PCR) plastic products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced recycling technologies including biofuel production from waste oils and biomass, lead refining from recycled batteries with CO2 reduction techniques, and manufacturing of PVC stabilizers and hydro talc additives. It employs proprietary pre-treatment processes for biodiesel feedstock, continuous centrifugation for wastewater reduction, and advanced separation and extraction methods for lithium recovery from battery blackmass. The company also invests in HVO pre-treatment and PCR process facilities to enhance production capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global oil refiners, shipping companies, power generation plants for bioenergy products, major battery manufacturers domestically and internationally for recycled lead, and construction material companies for plastic additives. The company serves both domestic and export markets, with significant sales to the US, Europe, and Asia. It maintains long-term contracts with battery manufacturers and supplies biofuels to certified overseas customers, emphasizing diversified global clientele.
categories.geographic_coverage: DS Dansuk operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing sites in Siheung, Pyeongtaek, Jecheon, and Gunsan, and overseas facilities in Malaysia, Pakistan, and China. Its sales and export markets span North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and other global regions. The company has established overseas sales offices and production bases to support its international market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It collects and processes waste raw materials (e.g., waste oils, used batteries, plastics) and manufactures refined biofuels, recycled metals, and chemical additives, supplying these products directly to end-users such as refiners, battery manufacturers, and construction material producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding into next-generation biofuels like HVO and bio-aviation fuels, developing lithium-ion battery recycling technologies, and advancing PCR plastic recycling capabilities. R&D efforts focus on improving feedstock pre-treatment, enhancing recycling efficiency, reducing environmental impact, and developing new eco-friendly materials. The company emphasizes innovation in sustainable resource recycling aligned with circular economy principles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of biofuels, recycled metals, and plastic additives. The company also earns income from goods trading, service contracts, and property leasing. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with major industrial customers and through agents for broader market reach, with payment terms varying by product and market.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: DS Dansuk holds a strong market position in South Korea’s bioenergy and battery recycling sectors, competing with a limited number of domestic firms in lead recycling and biofuel production. It differentiates itself by meeting stringent international certifications enabling exports to the US and Europe. The plastic additive market is highly competitive and mature, with DS Dansuk serving major domestic customers and expanding internationally. The company is recognized for technological expertise and stable supply capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, DS Dansuk reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.07 trillion KRW, with a balanced domestic and export sales mix. The company’s total assets reached about 719 billion KRW, and equity stood at 281 billion KRW, reflecting significant growth and improved financial structure following its 2023 stock market listing. Operating profit increased by 3% year-over-year, and net income rose by 44%, indicating enhanced profitability despite challenging global economic conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DS Dansuk emphasizes its role in the circular economy by converting waste materials into high-quality, environmentally friendly products. Its biofuels reduce harmful emissions and comply with international standards, enabling global market access. The company’s proprietary recycling technologies and quality control ensure product reliability and sustainability. Its integrated supply chain and diversified customer base provide stable revenue streams and competitive advantage in eco-friendly energy and materials sectors.
